loopId.description: The loop the cut is built around: the strongest one for a viewer who starts here

why.description: Two or three sentences: why this loop (cite the critic's scores and the loop map) and what the cut leaves out

title.description: A working title for the Reel

lineIds.description: The existing lines to keep, in script order. They may skip lines inside a loop to tighten it, and may start in the loop before, for the stakes

text.description: What the narrator says: one breath, spoken forms only (no digits or symbols)

showScene.description: A scene of the full video whose picture plays under this line (its background, characters and camera are copied); pick the one that shows the thing the line is about

hook.description: An optional new first line that states the stakes or the question at once; null when a kept line already does

text.description: What the narrator says: one breath, spoken forms only (no digits or symbols)

ending.description: An optional new last line that closes the loop and leaves a question open; null when the kept lines already do
